whatIs: Local SEO is the work of making a business appear when people nearby search for what it offers — in Google's map pack, on Google Maps and in "near me" results — by optimising its Google Business Profile, earning and answering reviews, keeping its name, address and phone number consistent across the web, and building location pages on its website. For a store, clinic, PG or showroom it is often the highest-return marketing there is.

At gaa-tha local SEO starts with the Google Business Profile, because that is what buyers see first: the right categories, complete services and products, current photos, weekly posts and a review process your staff can actually follow. For businesses with several outlets or cities we build a local landing page per location and manage every profile from one place.

faq.a: Local SEO is the practice of getting a business to appear in Google's map pack, on Google Maps and in "near me" searches for its area, mainly by optimising its Google Business Profile, earning reviews, keeping business details consistent across the web and building location pages. gaa-tha sets this up and runs it monthly for stores, showrooms, clinics, PGs and factories.

faq.q: How do I get into the top three on Google Maps?
faq.a: Google ranks local results on relevance, distance and prominence. You control relevance (correct categories, complete services, keyword-rich descriptions) and prominence (review count and recency, photos, posts, consistent citations, links from your website). Distance you cannot change, which is why multi-outlet businesses need a profile per location.

faq.q: Is a Google Business Profile free?
faq.a: Yes. Creating and managing a Google Business Profile is free, and so is appearing on Google Maps. What costs time is doing it properly and keeping it active; that is the part we handle, as a one-time setup or on a monthly retainer.

faq.q: How do we get more Google reviews?
faq.a: Ask at the right moment, make it effortless and reply to every one. We give your staff a QR code for the counter, WhatsApp follow-up templates for after purchase or delivery and a short script, and we respond to reviews within a day. We never buy or fake reviews; Google removes them and can suspend the profile.

faq.q: Can you manage several outlets or franchise locations?
faq.a: Yes. We set up one verified profile per location, manage them from a single business group, keep hours, offers and photos consistent, and build a local landing page for each outlet on your website so every profile has a matching page to link to.

faq.q: How long does local SEO take to work?
faq.a: Profile setup and verification take about two to three weeks. Calls and direction requests usually start rising within the first one to three months as reviews, photos and posts accumulate, and the position holds as long as the profile stays active.

faq.q: What documents does Google need to verify my business?
faq.a: Verification is usually by video call, postcard or phone, and Google may ask for proof such as a signboard, business registration, utility bill or GST certificate showing the name and address. Requirements change by category, so we check the current method for your business before starting.

faq.q: My profile has been suspended or has a duplicate — can you fix it?
faq.a: Usually, yes. Suspensions typically come from keyword-stuffed names, mismatched addresses, virtual offices or duplicate listings. We correct the profile to Google's guidelines, gather the evidence and file the reinstatement or merge request, then keep the profile compliant.
